title: Ruffle Slit Off-Shoulder Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Ruffle Slit Off-Shoulder Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Off-shoulder maternity photoshoot gown with short flutter sleeves, a high waist and a ruffled slit skirt. 6 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a soft off-the-shoulder gown with short flutter sleeves, a gathered high waist that sits above the bump, and a flowing skirt with a high ruffled slit that moves beautifully in the breeze.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
ruffled off-the-shoulder neckline, short flutter sleeves, gathered high waist, a flowing skirt with a high front slit edged with a cascading ruffle, and a short sweep train.
Synthetic fiber blend with a lightweight, flowing drape.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Dusty Blue, Champagne Gold, Dusty Pink, Ivory, Deep Emerald and Burgundy.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot. Choose by your bust today; the gathered high waist and flowing skirt leave room for the bump.
garment_lock: an off-the-shoulder maternity gown in lightweight flowing fabric: an elasticated ruffled off-shoulder neckline, short flutter sleeves, a gathered high waist that sits above the bump, and a full flowing skirt with a high front slit edged by a cascading ruffle, ending in a short sweep train

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Ruffle Slit Off-Shoulder Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in DUSTY BLUE (a muted grey-blue).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): an off-the-shoulder maternity gown in lightweight flowing fabric: an elasticated ruffled off-shoulder neckline, short flutter sleeves, a gathered high waist that sits above the bump, and a full flowing skirt with a high front slit edged by a cascading ruffle, ending in a short sweep train. Note: ref2 and ref3 show a lighter sky blue; use the dusty blue of ref1.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other gently lifting the skirt through the slit so the ruffle shows; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a wildflower meadow at golden hour, the flowing skirt and ruffle moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, skirt spread around the base, showing the off-shoulder neckline, flutter sleeves, high waist and ruffled slit clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: dusty blue colour (muted grey-blue), off-the-shoulder gathered neckline, short flutter sleeves, gathered high waist, long flowing skirt with a high front slit and a cascading ruffle along the slit edge, short sweep train. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment, no belt, no sequins.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
